dead-letter:ingest-q.title: Ingest jobs has no dead-letter queue
dead-letter:ingest-q.message: If Chunk and embed can't handle a message, it's dropped after 5 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.
dead-letter:ingest-q.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.
